name: Multi SIM
description: Windows MDM settings in the Multi SIM category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Is Selected
properties.description: Indicates whether this Slot is selected or not.

properties.name: Modem ID
properties.description: Node representing a Mobile Broadband Modem. The node name is the Modem ID. Modem ID is a GUID without curly braces, with exception of "Embedded" which represents the embedded Modem.

properties.name: Slot ID
properties.description: Node representing a SIM Slot. The node name is the Slot ID. SIM Slot ID format is "0", "1", etc., with exception of "Embedded" which represents the embedded Slot.

properties.name: Slot ID
properties.description: Node representing a SIM Slot. The node name is the Slot ID. SIM Slot ID format is "0", "1", etc., with exception of "Embedded" which represents the embedded Slot.

properties.name: Slot Selection Enabled
properties.description: Determines whether the user is allowed to change slots in the Cellular settings UI. Default is true.
